name: Firefox Gecko iOS
subtitle: Experimental Gecko-powered iOS browser
description: Development releases of an independently built Gecko iOS browser based on Reynard. Not an official Mozilla Firefox distribution. IPAs must be re-signed for installation.

apps.name: Firefox Gecko
apps.subtitle: Experimental Gecko browser with download Live Activity
apps.localizedDescription: Independent Gecko-powered iOS browser prototype based on Reynard, with experimental JIT pairing support and a download Live Activity. Unsigned IPA: re-sign with all extensions before installation. Firefox-style UI and default-browser eligibility remain under development.

versions.localizedDescription: Experimental Gecko iOS prototype. Full IPA build passed; JIT pairing and download widget packaged. Requires re-signing.
